offering_sistemaReservas.name: Booking system
offering_sistemaReservas.tagline: Book appointments, classes or shifts with synced calendars
offering_sistemaReservas.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "Booking system". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with reservations with confirmation
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and reservations with confirmation

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of reservations with confirmation
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of reservations with confirmation
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_sistemaReservas.costoNote: SMS/WhatsApp (~$20–$6,000 USD/mo) and payment gateway are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
